# AbroadReady

> AbroadReady helps students find and apply for fully funded and partial international scholarships. Free AI-powered matching, live deadlines, step-by-step application guides, an SOP builder and an AI advisor.

Key pages:
- [Scholarships](https://abroadready.org/pages/scholarships): Browse 60+ fully funded scholarships filterable by country, degree and deadline.
- [Study Abroad Guides](https://abroadready.org/pages/study): Country-by-country guides to tuition, universities, visas and costs.
- [Immigration Guides](https://abroadready.org/pages/immigration): Work visa and permanent residency pathways for 14 countries.
- [Student Visa Guidance](https://abroadready.org/pages/visa-guidance): Visa fees, documents and timelines for every country.
- [Internships](https://abroadready.org/pages/internships): Funded internship programmes with stipends and deadlines.
- [AI Advisor](https://abroadready.org/pages/ai-advisor): Free AI answers to scholarship and visa questions.
- [Blog](https://abroadready.org/pages/blog): All in-depth guides.

## Articles
- [Chevening Scholarship: The Complete Guide](https://abroadready.org/pages/chevening-scholarship-complete-guide): Everything you need to know about the Chevening Scholarship, from eligibility and funding to the four essays, interview, and university offer deadline.
- [Fulbright Foreign Student Program: How to Apply](https://abroadready.org/pages/fulbright-foreign-student-program-how-to-apply): A step-by-step guide to the Fulbright Foreign Student Program covering eligibility, funding, essays, interviews, and how to craft a winning application.
- [DAAD Scholarships: Fund Your Study in Germany](https://abroadready.org/pages/daad-scholarships-explained-study-in-germany): Understand the DAAD scholarship, from EPOS and study grants to research funding, plus eligibility, benefits, and a step-by-step application guide.
- [Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://abroadready.org/pages/erasmus-mundus-joint-masters-step-by-step-guide): Learn how Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters and their fully funded EU scholarships work, plus eligibility, deadlines, and a step-by-step application guide.
- [Study in Germany for Free: Tuition-Free Universities](https://abroadready.org/pages/how-to-study-in-germany-for-free): A practical guide to studying in Germany for free, covering tuition-free public universities, real costs, visa proof of funds, and living-cost scholarships.
- [Study in the UK on a Full Scholarship](https://abroadready.org/pages/study-in-the-uk-full-scholarship-options): The major fully funded routes to study in the UK, who runs them, who qualifies, and how to build an application that wins.
- [Scholarships to Study in Canada: A Complete Guide](https://abroadready.org/pages/scholarships-to-study-in-canada-complete-guide): How Canadian scholarship funding works across federal, provincial, and university levels, and how to find the right award for your level of study.
- [Australia Awards & RTP: Study in Australia Funding](https://abroadready.org/pages/australia-awards-rtp-funding-study-in-australia): How the Australia Awards and the Research Training Program fund international students, and how to apply for each successfully.
- [MEXT Scholarship: Study in Japan Fully Funded](https://abroadready.org/pages/mext-scholarship-study-in-japan-fully-funded): Everything you need to know about the MEXT scholarship, Japan's fully funded government award, including the two application routes and how to apply.

- [How to Write a Winning Statement of Purpose (SOP)](https://abroadready.org/pages/how-to-write-a-winning-statement-of-purpose): A step-by-step guide to writing a statement of purpose that admissions committees remember, with a proven structure, paragraph-by-paragraph examples, and an editing checklist.
- [10 Statement of Purpose Mistakes to Avoid](https://abroadready.org/pages/10-statement-of-purpose-mistakes-that-get-you-rejected): The ten statement of purpose mistakes that quietly sink strong applicants, why each one hurts, and exactly how to fix it before you submit.
- [How to Write a Scholarship Motivation Letter](https://abroadready.org/pages/how-to-write-a-scholarship-motivation-letter): A practical guide to writing a scholarship motivation letter that convinces funders you are worth the investment, with structure, examples, and an editing checklist.
- [Personal Statement vs Statement of Purpose](https://abroadready.org/pages/personal-statement-vs-statement-of-purpose): A clear breakdown of personal statement vs statement of purpose, including how they differ in focus and tone, when each is required, and how to write both well.
- [How to Get Strong Letters of Recommendation](https://abroadready.org/pages/how-to-get-strong-letters-of-recommendation): A complete guide to securing strong letters of recommendation, from choosing the right recommenders to giving them the materials that produce a specific, powerful letter.
- [Turkiye Burslari Scholarship: The Complete Guide](https://abroadready.org/pages/turkiye-burslari-scholarship-complete-guide): Everything international students need to know about the Turkiye Burslari scholarship, from eligibility and benefits to a step-by-step application walkthrough and interview tips.
- [Fully Funded PhD Scholarships Around the World](https://abroadready.org/pages/fully-funded-phd-scholarships-around-the-world): A practical guide to fully funded PhD scholarships around the world, including where to look, what they cover, and how to build an application that stands out.
- [Fully Funded Masters Scholarships Without IELTS](https://abroadready.org/pages/fully-funded-masters-scholarships-no-ielts-required): A clear guide to fully funded masters scholarships without IELTS, including how English waivers work and what alternatives universities accept.

- [IELTS 7+ in 6 Weeks: A Realistic IELTS Study Plan](https://abroadready.org/pages/ielts-7-plus-6-weeks-study-plan): A week-by-week IELTS study plan that takes you from your current level to a Band 7 or higher in six focused weeks, with section-specific strategies and honest expectations.
- [TOEFL vs IELTS: Which English Test Should You Take?](https://abroadready.org/pages/toefl-vs-ielts-which-test): A practical comparison of TOEFL vs IELTS covering format, scoring, difficulty, and acceptance, so you can confidently choose the test that plays to your strengths.

- [How to Prepare for a Chevening Interview](https://abroadready.org/pages/how-to-prepare-chevening-interview): Everything you need to prepare for a Chevening interview, from the panel format and core question themes to structuring answers on leadership, networking, and your UK study choices.
- [How to Build a Competitive Scholarship Profile](https://abroadready.org/pages/how-to-build-competitive-scholarship-profile): A step-by-step guide to building a competitive scholarship profile, covering academics, leadership, community impact, and the narrative that ties it all together.
- [Scholarship Application Timeline for Fall Intake](https://abroadready.org/pages/complete-timeline-fall-intake-scholarships): Fall-intake scholarships reward students who start early. This month-by-month scholarship application timeline shows exactly what to do and when, from initial research to accepting your award.
- [How to Find Scholarships You're Eligible For](https://abroadready.org/pages/how-to-find-scholarships-actually-eligible): Most students waste hours on scholarships they can never win. This guide shows how to find scholarships you are genuinely eligible for, using a repeatable filtering system.

Learn how to fund studies abroad by combining partial awards, work, savings, and smart budgeting into a realistic plan.

- [IAESTE Internships: Paid Work Abroad for STEM](https://abroadready.org/pages/iaeste-internships-abroad-paid-work-experience): A guide to IAESTE internships: paid STEM traineeships abroad through a national committee, covering eligibility, funding, the application process and practical tips.
